bio: The Gasthaus, which annexes the Kulturhof Stanggass located on the road between Bischofswiesen and Berchtesgaden, offers a culinary alternative to the restaurant Solo Du. Done out in light wood, the minimalist-style interior has a modern yet cosy feel. The glass façade affords views of the garden, which includes a children's playground. Book a spot at the Stammtisch, a long handmade wooden table for 25 diners. The menu draws on the region and nature's bounty – the ingredients are locally sourced. The good food is complemented by friendly service....
